boundedExactWaitCandidate.acceptanceRule: A newly confirmed exact-child reap permits one fresh group probe. Reap itself does not establish an empty group.
alternativesRejected: A delay followed by a new group probe without exact-child reap does not provide the required lifecycle evidence.
Ignoring EPERM, declaring the group gone, or signalling first would weaken ownership/cleanup evidence.
boundedExactWaitCandidate.assessment: Supported as a minimal fail-closed candidate; independent immutable patch review and a new short Mac gate are separate requirements.
boundedExactWaitCandidate.boundary: Only an exact Popen child with returncode still unset after the existing polls may receive one wait(timeout=0.05).
negativeRules: Already-reaped child must not permit an extra wait or bypass a denied group.
Wait timeout preserves the original PermissionError without publishing TimeoutExpired command context.
Wait without a confirmed returncode must not permit a fresh probe.
Fresh probe true remains alive; fresh EPERM or other errors remain unverified/fail-closed.
No extra signal, privilege, target exclusion, unknown-to-zero counter or query retry is introduced.

findings.cleanupGuarantee: This failed test does not establish successful group cleanup. Successful cleanup in other tests cannot fill that gap.
findings.observation: Expected monitor-unavailable was raised first. During finally cleanup, stop called owned_group_alive, whose initial group signal-zero probe raised EPERM. The existing already-reaped-or-second-poll guard did not permit a fresh group probe and PermissionError escaped. The log does not expose the runtime returncode/poll values or which guard operand rejected recovery.
findings.rootCause: UNKNOWN: leader state, waitability, birth and group membership were not captured at the denied instant. An exit-to-waitable transition is a hypothesis, not a demonstrated cause.

fullCandidate.activationDecision: NO_GO because the required complete diagnostic pass was not obtained
